availability.note: GWM AU offers page lists the H6 Lux PHEV (MY26, 2026 build) with a VIC private drive-away price, as of 1/11/2026; H6 model page lists the same eight grades incl. Lux PHEV, Ultra PHEV, Ultra PHEV AWD. Build & Price at https://www.gwmanz.com/au/ is script-rendered. CarExpert 2026 review and CarExpert/GoAuto launch articles agree on three PHEV grades.

listPrice.note: GWM publishes drive-away only: $44,990 'Driveaway from', 'Price based on private buyers in VIC', 2026 build; the 'additional $4,000 off the driveaway price' campaign ending 30 Nov 2026 is ignored. (44990 - 880) / 1.042 = 42332; round-trip through calc/onroad.js driveAwayPrice (green, passenger) = 44,989.94. The same figure is quoted as a national drive-away (GoAuto '*National driveaway price', CarExpert 'Drive-away pricing' Sydney basis, unchanged since Sep 2025 launch), so it is a flat national figure, not a per-state calculation; no independent on-road estimate to verify against. Held value (RedBook MSRP via CarsGuide, $43,490) would put the VIC drive-away about $1,200-$1,460 above GWM's own advertised drive-away, so GWM's figure (owner convention: manufacturer's price) wins.

batteryKwh.note: 'Maximum battery kilowatt hour: 19.09 kWh' LFP; also CarExpert AWD review and CarsGuide. Unlabelled; usable vs gross not published.

rangeKm.note: 'Range: 106 km'; GWM powertrains page 'up to 106km', GWM internal testing, ADR 81/02 (NEDC-based). No WLTP figure exists: the H6 PHEV is not sold in WLTP markets (Auto Express: UK/EU H6 is hybrid only).

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 19.09 / 106 x 100 = 18.01; no published EV-mode figure (held 18.4 was an unlabelled database figure, possibly ADR label, so replaced). Tautological against the cross-check.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: No published charge-sustaining figure. Derived from GWM's total-range claim (1,106km, top of the 1,043-1,106km band, 2WD) with 106km EV range and 55L tank: (1106 - 106) / 55 = 18.18 km/L = 5.5 L/100km. Same method as sibling GWM PHEVs; matches CarExpert's claimed 5.5 L/100km 'with low battery'. Lighter than the AWD, so lower than its 5.8.

combinedRangeKm.note: rangeKm + tank / fuelConsumptionL100km x 100 = 106 + 55 / 5.5 x 100 = 1106. Tank 55L (CarExpert Lux spec 'Capacity: 55 L'). Equals GWM's NEDC 1,106km.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: Combined label 'Combined: 1 L/100km' (ADR 81/02); GWM powertrains page 1.0-1.1 L/100km. At or below 3.5.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO: green cars are passenger cars with combined CO2 of 120 g/km or less; GWM powertrains page lists 22-25 g/km for the PHEVs.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 'Rear seat up; to lower window: 560 L' (to the cargo cover); same 560L on the AWD per CarExpert review and Chasing Cars ('560 litres across the range').

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: 'Rear seat down: 1,445 L'; same on AWD per CarExpert review and Chasing Cars.

towKg.note: Braked 1500kg ('Gross trailer weight braked: 1,500 kg' on the Lux spec page; 1500kg in the AWD review and CarsGuide).

warrantyYears.note: '7-year unlimited-km vehicle warranty' on the GWM H6 page; CarExpert: 84 months unlimited km, battery 96 months unlimited km. No servicing condition stated.

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored to byd-sealion-6-essential (1450 at $42,990) and chery-tiggo-7-phev-urban/ultimate (1450/1550 at $37,990/$41,990); held value unchanged.

depreciationCurve.note: Owner convention one curve per brand: adopted the GWM curve used by gwm-cannon-phev (refreshed 2026-11-26) and gwm-cannon-alpha-phev, replacing the held [1,0.71,0.6,0.52,0.45,0.39]. Evidence for below-mainstream retention: recurring extra $4,000-$5,000 drive-away discounts on top of national drive-away pricing (GWM offers page, to 30 Nov 2026), and RedBook MSRP sits above the advertised drive-away.
